biocontainers.name: spliceai
biocontainers.summary: A deep learning-based tool to identify splice variants.

biotools.summary: SpliceAI Pangolin is a web service that predicts the impact of genetic variants on RNA splicing using SpliceAI and Pangolin models. It helps diagnose variants affecting splicing in diseases like Alagille syndrome.
